exercises.instructions: Choose the correct article (a/an, the, or no article -) for each blank.

questions.question: It is ___ beautiful day and ___ sun is shining.
questions.explanation: Use 'a' before 'beautiful' (consonant sound, first mention). Use 'the' before 'sun' (unique thing). 'beautiful day' အတွက် 'a' သုံးပါ၊ 'sun' က unique thing ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'the' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ___ young girl walks into a restaurant. ___ girl sits down and orders a pizza.
questions.explanation: Use 'A' for the first mention of 'young girl'. Use 'The' for the second mention (already known). 'Young girl' ပထမဆုံး ပြောတဲ့အခါ 'A' သုံးပါ၊ နောက်တစ်ခါ ပြောတဲ့အခါ 'The' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: My cousin loves ___ books. He is ___ writer.
questions.explanation: Use no article with 'books' (general, plural). Use 'a' before 'writer' (profession). 'books' က general statement ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် article မသုံးပါ၊ 'writer' က profession ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'a' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Pete's uncle is ___ doctor. He says ___ exercise is good for you.
questions.explanation: Use 'a' before 'doctor' (profession). Use no article with 'exercise' (general, uncountable). 'doctor' က profession ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'a' သုံးပါ၊ 'exercise' က general statement ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် article မသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She has got a brother and ___ sister.
questions.explanation: Use 'a' before 'sister' (singular, countable, first mention, parallel with 'a brother'). 'sister' က singular countable noun ဖြစ်ပြီး first mention ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'a' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Do you listen to ___ music at dinnertime?
questions.explanation: Use no article with 'music' (general, uncountable). 'music' က general statement ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် article မသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Do you think ___ food you eat makes a difference to your school marks?
questions.explanation: Use 'the' because 'food you eat' is specific (the food that you eat, not any food). 'food you eat' က specific thing ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'the' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I think ___ communication is essential.
questions.explanation: Use no article with 'communication' (general, uncountable). 'communication' က general statement ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် article မသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Family dinners are ___ important moment of us.
questions.explanation: Use 'an' before 'important' (vowel sound, first mention). 'important' ရဲ့ sound က vowel sound ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'an' သုံးပါ။
